info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Loan By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to modify specific attributes of loan applications based on a unique identifier. The PATCH operation enables the selective updating of loan application details, enhancing user experience by allowing targeted changes without resubmitting the entire application. This service is especially useful for financial institutions and service providers looking to streamline loan processing. Typical consumers include loan officers, backend systems, and integration services within the financial domain.

patch.summary: Update loan application with ID RES-100045
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific loan application identified by its unique ID. Ensure that all required fields are properly included in the request to successfully process the update.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the loan application with the specified ID. It allows for partial modifications, meaning that only the fields provided in the request will be updated. Ensure to include the necessary fields that you wish to update and adhere to the schema defined.
